a:r.a:t: Source: final_paper_1232964_japluxhwcn2mph76_v2(2).pdf, especially Sections II–IV and Tables I–II. The minimum detector-silent logical mechanism weight plays a distance-like role. The reported screen is a search-dependent verified upper bound and depends on randomized BP+OSD search. It is not code distance or exact DEM distance. There are 45 screen ties among 226 Wilson-ordered pairs. Secondary Kendall tau_b: 0.5627, two-sided p = 0.0007. Code-resampling draws: 20,000 / 20,000. For a question about the isolated screen-8 point: it is one tested instance, not evidence of a statistical outlier; the paper does not establish an instance-specific explanation. Further operating points, decoder transfer and cost savings require separate prospective tests.
